summary: Canadian National Railway filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release, interim financial statements, MD&A and CEO/CFO certifications. Results show revenue of C$4,771 million (+15%), diluted EPS of C$2.00 (+9%) and adjusted diluted EPS of C$2.16 (+18%), with an adjusted operating ratio of 61.0%. Free cash flow for the nine months reached C$2,918 million (+25%). CN repurchased roughly 3.9 million shares for C$676 million during the quarter. No transaction, strategic review, or board recommendation is disclosed; the filing is routine periodic reporting.
